name: wobble-card
title: Wobble Card
description: A rounded content card with an indigo gradient and faint grain. The whole card follows the pointer a little, and the text inside slides opposite and scales slightly for depth.
use: A feature or promo card should feel physical and respond to the cursor without a full 3D scene.
avoid: The tilt is mouse-only, so touch users get a still card, and the indigo gradient is fixed.
a11y: The tilt is decorative and pointer-only; there is no keyboard or touch equivalent and no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded card filled with an indigo-to-violet gradient that glows lighter at the top, holding a bold white heading and two lines of pale body copy left-aligned. A soft radial highlight and faint grain cover the surface.
behaves: Moving the pointer over the card nudges it toward the cursor while the inner text shifts the opposite way and grows a touch. It settles back to centre when the pointer leaves.
customise: Drop any heading and copy in as children; adjust the outer size and inner padding with containerClassName and className. The indigo gradient, shadow and noise image are fixed.
weight: light: One card with a couple of CSS transform transitions and a static noise image.
